name: apple
description: A popular fruit grown in temperate climates.
general_information: Requires chilling hours during winter to produce fruit.

name: banana
description: A tropical fruit requiring warm temperatures and high moisture.
general_information: Bananas are fast-growing herbaceous plants, not trees.

name: blackgram
description: Also known as urad dal, a widely grown pulse crop.
general_information: It improves soil fertility by fixing atmospheric nitrogen.

name: chickpea
description: A cool season legume crop.
general_information: Highly sensitive to waterlogging.

name: coconut
description: A versatile tropical palm tree.
general_information: Tolerant to salinity and prefers coastal areas.

name: coffee
description: A highly valuable tropical beverage crop.
soil_type: Well-drained volcanic soil or forest loam
general_information: Thrives at higher altitudes with distinct dry and wet seasons.

name: cotton
description: A major fiber crop grown in tropical and subtropical regions.
soil_type: Deep black soil or alluvial soil
general_information: Highly sensitive to frost.

name: grapes
description: A woody vine fruit crop.
general_information: Requires pruning for optimal yield.

name: jute
description: A long, soft, shiny bast fiber crop.
general_information: Grows best in warm and humid climates with plenty of rainfall.

name: kidneybeans
description: Also known as rajma, an important pulse crop.
general_information: Does not tolerate waterlogging or high salinity.

name: lentil
description: An edible legume, known for its lens-shaped seeds.
general_information: A drought-tolerant crop grown during the winter season.

name: maize
description: Corn, a widely grown cereal grain.
general_information: Highly responsive to nitrogen fertilizer.

name: mango
description: A tropical stone fruit.
general_information: Requires dry weather during flowering for good fruit set.

name: mothbeans
description: A drought-resistant legume.
general_information: One of the most drought-resistant pulses.

name: mungbean
description: Green gram, a short-duration pulse crop.
general_information: Excellent for crop rotation to restore soil fertility.

name: muskmelon
description: A sweet, fleshy fruit grown on trailing vines.
general_information: Requires plenty of sunlight and warm temperatures.

name: orange
description: A widely cultivated citrus fruit.
general_information: Intolerant to severe frosts and waterlogged soils.

name: papaya
description: A fast-growing tropical fruit.
general_information: Extremely susceptible to waterlogging.

name: pigeonpeas
description: Also known as toor dal, a major pulse crop.
general_information: Deep root system makes it highly drought tolerant.

name: pomegranate
description: A drought-tolerant fruit-bearing deciduous shrub.
general_information: Thrives in semi-arid conditions.

name: rice
description: A staple cereal grain requiring submerged conditions.
general_information: Grows best in flooded fields.

name: watermelon
description: A large, sweet summer fruit.
general_information: Needs warm weather and plenty of space to vine.
